algorithm: kmeans (k=4) on PC1-PC5; tskmeans on 168-h profiles as orthogonal axis
naming_rule: quadrant of (volume_index, congestion_index) + temporal modifier + POI phrase

anomaly_rules.spatial: top 2% of distance to own centroid in PC1-PC5 AND robust z >= 2
anomaly_rules.temporal: top 2% of L2 distance to own cluster mean 168-h profile AND robust z >= 2
anomaly_rules.daily: |Poisson z| >= 2.5 (or robust z of median speed) with >= 30 sampled trips

limitation: taxis, not buses: no fixed stops, no timetable, no schedule delay
limitation_text: Real GPS from Porto taxis (UCI 339), not city buses. There are no fixed stops, no timetable and no schedule delay to measure, so route-segment delay and stop profiles cannot be computed from this source. 'Dwell' is below-walking-pace time, which mixes kerbside waiting, parking and traffic. Cluster names describe taxi movement, not passenger demand.
